about: The eleven browser flows of document 10 §2, each with the steps of scripts/os-journeys.mjs that press it. Checked by scripts/verify-acceptance.mjs: the wording must be the specification's and every named step must exist in the script.

states.covered: the whole flow is pressed in a browser
states.partly: some of its steps are pressed

steps: create a lead from the New menu
the lead is still there after a reload, and its page opens
flows.note: A member of staff creates the lead, in both journeys. The shop's public form is not in a journey: the React shop does not write to Laravel yet.

steps: an enquiry is taken and handed to a sales person, with the reason on record
the sales person finds the enquiry among their own leads
the lead is won and the contact has become a client
flows.note: The assignment rule gives a new enquiry to somebody; the owner hands it on, is asked why, and the reason is on the timeline. The client's yes moves the lead to Won and makes the contact a client.

steps: write a draft quotation for that client
price one line; the total follows
a figure typed into the quotation is kept when a menu link is pressed at once
the quotation PDF
the same PDF is drawn on the screen (the preview: a worker, a later script, the fonts)
documents can be issued here: terms and a signer are in place
a quotation above the discount limit cannot be sent: approval is asked for
the approver finds the request in the queue and approves it
the approved quotation is sent: frozen, with its PDF
the client says yes
flows.note: Pressed on the rehearsal both ways: with the client's own pages open (the demo) the client accepts on a phone without a sign-in; with them off (the product as it ships) the sales person writes the answer down. On a site whose owner has not confirmed terms and signers nothing can be sent, and the journey reports the site's reason instead of failing (T-084).

steps: accounts bill the sale in full and issue the invoice; the ledger has it
the advance is paid and confirmed against the invoice
the receipt is a numbered PDF
the sales person sees on the lead that the invoice went out and the money came in
flows.note: One invoice of 496,800 and one payment of 372,600 set against it: balance 124,200, status Partially Paid, receipt as a PDF. With the client's pages open the client reports the payment with a bank slip and accounts confirm it; with them off accounts take it on the invoice. A payment spread over several invoices is proven by tests (AS-08, AS-09), not pressed.

steps: find a product of the real catalogue by its code, and open it
flows.note: Browsing only, on the real catalogue, in the journeys this table counts. A product made in the admin and read by a visitor on the shop is pressed by a journey of its own (`scripts/os-product-to-shop.mjs`, document 45). Orders do not exist in Laravel.

A Furniture sale opens a project, but the project screen still carries the stages, the hand-over checklist and the site updates of the Interior module. A journey waits for Furniture's own job steps (T-010, T-033).

flows.text: Page edit, preview, approval and publish.

steps: a sales person is told plainly what they may not open
a page that does not exist gets the admin's own 404
sign out; the admin asks for a sign-in again
